an4.237:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an4.237:1.5: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.237:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.237:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.237:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.237:4.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.237:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.237:5.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.237:5.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.237:5.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
